Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. is a chemical enterprise located at No. 136, Qingchun Road, Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China. Based in one of China’s most dynamic commercial and industrial regions, the company benefits from Hangzhou’s strong transportation network, developed business environment, and access to advanced manufacturing and research resources. As a company operating in the chemical and new materials sector, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. is positioned to serve customers requiring chemical products, material solutions, and related technical support across a variety of industrial applications.

The company’s location in Zhejiang Province provides strategic advantages for both domestic and international business cooperation. Zhejiang is known for its active private economy, strong supply chain capabilities, and well-established chemical, textile, manufacturing, and export industries. This regional background supports the company’s ability to connect with manufacturers, distributors, and end users in multiple markets.

Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. focuses on the development and supply of chemical materials that can support modern industrial production. In the chemical new materials field, product quality, stable supply, technical knowledge, and responsible business practices are essential. The company aims to meet customer requirements by emphasizing dependable service, practical solutions, and long-term cooperation.

With its presence in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. is well placed to participate in China’s growing chemical materials industry. The company represents the type of modern chemical enterprise that supports industrial upgrading, product innovation, and the increasing demand for high-performance materials. Through continuous improvement and customer-oriented service, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. can build strong relationships with partners in China and abroad.
